description: This file defines the ModifyPolicy command class, which is used to modify an existing Policy object within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, getters for policy data, and serialization logic.

classes.name: ModifyPolicy
classes.description: A command class for modifying existing policies within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles creation from various inputs, serialization, and comparison logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyPolicy with specified PolicyId, Policy, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ModifyPolicy instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the Policy object that this command modifies.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this modify command.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Provides the JSON representation of the Policy, optionally versioned.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the resource, here an empty pointer.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command payload into a JSON object builder.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ModifyPolicy with updated headers.
